_meta.note: The same shell-command turn where the client answers session/request_permission with abort (reject_once). The command does NOT run: its execute tool_call_update is `failed`, and no `completed` execute tool_call_update carrying the command output follows. So the deny stops the command. Covers agent_message_chunk, tool_call, session/request_permission, the failed tool_call_update, and the session/prompt result with stopReason. Reductions: session id -> muse-session-1, permission id -> perm-1, uuids/tool-call ids -> fixed synthetic values; home/scratch paths -> ~; this host retried the command several times after the deny -- only the first tool_call/permission/failed triple and the terminal result are kept, which is the shape the class pins. The ids are synthetic; nothing else is altered.
